title: The Informant

panels.shot: The palm house wrecked. Snow falls through the broken dome onto the palms. Vane kneels in shattered glass, her medals torn off. A clock at 3:17 in the background.

lines.speaker: Vane
lines.text: The Board leaves tonight. You're too late. You were always going to be.

panels.shot: Through a glass office wall: Inspector Hale (trench coat, hat) on the phone, his back turned. Nero growls at the glass.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: He's on schedule, Maestro. Vane's done. Next, the train.

panels.shot: A thin sabre bursts through the glass and through Hale. Behind the cracks, a pale man in a white suit (Lenz) bows and leaves into the snow.

lines.text: My informant. His leads were never his. Someone was writing my score.

panels.shot: Close-up. The hero holds Hale's bloody notebook: Meridian Express, 23:40, Platform 9. The Board leaves with the ledgers. Nero sniffs Hale's coat and whines.

lines.text: The last train out of Valmora. I had a ticket.

panels.shot: Close-up. The phone receiver hangs from its cord over the broken glass. The line is still open.

lines.text: On the other end, a clock was ticking. Then someone hung up.
